rule_or_pattern: Drop every line with width_ratio > 0.6 (wider than one column), on ALL pages of this book, including pages where page_n_columns was detected as 1. The print is two-column throughout, so any line wider than ~0.6 of the text width is two half-lines joined across the gutter.
notes: This is an 1882 two-column session record. Lines confined to one column (width_ratio ~0.47: 1, 4, 7, 8, 14, 15, 17) read correctly with full polytonic marks. Every full-width line (width_ratio ~0.95-1.0) is two columns merged, with the '|' gutter rule visible in the crop, and many labels in 21-40 run on past the crop. The pool gutter rule misses lines 5, 6, 10, 11, 12 and 19, because their pages were detected as one column (page_n_columns=1, no D:column_crossing flag), so the width-based rule is needed. About half the book remains after the drop.
